steps.source_text: Assign the fully stained sample, unstained control, isotype control, and five single-antibody compensation controls.
Aliquot 100 uL PBMC suspension, corresponding to 1 x 10^6 cells, into each assigned tube.

steps.section: Initial Wash and Fc Receptor Blocking
steps.source_text: Wash all assigned tubes at 300 x g for 5 min at 4 C and retain each cell pellet.

steps.section: Initial Wash and Fc Receptor Blocking
steps.source_text: Resuspend each pellet, add Fc receptor blocking reagent, mix, and incubate on ice.
Prepare the full antibody and viability staining panel.
Prepare the isotype, five single-antibody, and unstained-control reagents.
Apply each staining reagent to its assigned tube, mix, and incubate on ice protected from light.
Wash every stained or control tube twice and retain the cell pellet after each centrifugation.
Fix each retained cell pellet, mix, and incubate at room temperature protected from light.
Wash the fixed cells, resuspend them in acquisition buffer, and hold them cold and protected from light.
Acquire and return eight separately identified event streams with raw signals, control roles, acquisition metadata, and quality fields.
